cs.t: At work I use a single Dell 38" 21:9 ultrawide curved. Ultrawide + curved is 100% the way to go for productivity imho. Make sure you get a monitor with 1440 vertical resolution and not 1080. At home I use a single flat 27" 16:9 1440p 144Hz so I can game. I wrote my own, super simple Windows tool to help control window placement.  https://github.com/forrestthewoods/fts_winsnap
cs.th: Ask HN: Ultrawide monitors, what's your experience been like?
